# opnsense_dnsmasq_tag (Resource)

Dnsmasq tags (**Services ▸ Dnsmasq DNS & DHCP ▸ DHCP tags**) label DHCP clients, ranges and options so options can be sent selectively.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_dnsmasq_tag" "pxe" {
  tag = "pxe"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (String) Name of the tag.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the dnsmasq tag.

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import opnsense_dnsmasq_tag using the `id`. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_dnsmasq_tag.example
  id = "<opnsense-resource-id>"
}
```

Using `terraform import`, import opnsense_dnsmasq_tag using the `id`. For example:

```console
% terraform import opnsense_dnsmasq_tag.example <opnsense-resource-id>
```
